archive_identity_basis: This audit recomputes all39 archive SHA256 and compares source/prediction manifests; tar roots are checked against repo/base. Source payload is only decoded for referenced Python old-side files.
method: Independent hunk counter parser (does not call study scoring.edit_targets); old-side deletion+context text checked at fixed base coordinates, Python encoding detected with tokenize, CRLF line separators normalized; all other whitespace exact. Only selected patch column decoded; no issue text inspected. Source tar members read only for Python old-side files referenced by selected patches. Resource caps derived from sorted tar headers, not indexing.
limitations: Patch-to-source agreement validates coordinate identity, not usefulness, unique repair or necessary context.
Non-Python files are categorized and retained in counts but their content is not audited.
New files have no base side and contribute no removed-base-line target; pure insertions explicitly retain absent targets.
Source execution, prediction rerun, result modification and publication were not performed.
Line occurrence counts include context reused across hunks/tasks; they are not independent tasks.
No-newline diff markers are accepted; this checks decoded line content/coordinates, not original EOL-byte identity.
implementation_notes: First audit attempt hit the standard CSV 131072-byte field limit before any source comparison; an explicit 32MiB parsing field bound was then set. This is an audit-reader parameter, not a change to experimental resource bounds.
